tasks.spec:
You are a Python engineer. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (detached at HEAD). Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, never touch /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge itself, never run `uv`, NEVER call a model, NEVER use the network, NEVER run npm, playwright or the bench. FIRST run: [ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv . Environment for every command: `export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp`. Ruff: `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check <files>` and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format <files>` (line length 120, Python 3.12, standard library plus what the repo already uses). Never pass --cov to pytest. Run tests as `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py`.

BACKGROUND. The dark factory (`factory/`, read `factory/followups.py`, `factory/tickets.py`, `factory/line.py` and `factory/stations/triage.py` first) turns failing playtest turns into tickets. A `story_data` ticket's payload is `{"parent": str, "class": "story_data", "failing_turns": [packet, ...], "rules": {key: rule}}`; each packet is a dict with at least `key` (like `1A-r1-t6`), `scene`, `player_input`, `narration`, `candidates_offered` (reveal ids), `matched_candidate`, `outcome` (see `report_to_packets` in `factory/stations/live_playtest.py` for the exact keys). Station 4 will have a planner model propose ONE fix and a deterministic lint accept or reject it. You build the two free parts in a new module `factory/stations/fix_plan.py`. Do not edit any other source file.

THE SUPPORTED FIX MENU (only techniques the project already uses; see `docs/scene-fixing-guide.md`). Precedents: an authored pacing beat that points the player at the next move (`reyes_rams_drawer_1a` and `supervisor_impatience_2a` in `data/stories/continuity-initiative/source/scenes/`), and a reveal handoff sentence changed through the story CLI (`claim:<id>.text`). Anything else is out of menu.

BUILD.
(1) `PLAN_VERSION = 1` and the plan format, a JSON object: {"version": 1, "ticket_id": str, "scene": str, "kind": "add_pacing_beat" | "set_text", "reason": str, "evidence_keys": [str, ...], "beat": {"id": str, "at_turn": int, "text": str, "verbatim": bool, "trailing": bool, "when": {fact_id: bool}, "sets": {fact_id: bool}}  (kind add_pacing_beat only), "set_text": {"address": str, "text": str}  (kind set_text only)}.
(2) `lint_plan(plan: dict, ticket_payload: dict, package) -> list[str]`: returns problem strings, each starting with a rule id, empty when the plan is acceptable. `package` is a loaded `StoryPackage` (`storygame.story_package.loader.load_story_package`). Rules, all deterministic, none story-specific (the module must contain no story-specific words, character names or fact ids): `plan.shape` (required keys and types, no extra top-level keys, exactly the sub-object that matches `kind`); `plan.kind` (kind in the menu above); `plan.scene` (the scene exists in the package and equals the ticket scene, which is `ticket_payload["scene"]` when present else the scene of the first failing packet); `plan.evidence` (evidence_keys is non-empty and every key is the `key` of a packet in `ticket_payload["failing_turns"]`); `plan.reason` (non-blank, at most 400 characters); for add_pacing_beat: `plan.beat_id` (matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*_<scene lowercased>$` and is not the id of any existing pacing event, `package.pacing.events`), `plan.beat_turn` (an integer with 1 <= at_turn <= handoff - 1 where handoff is the scene's `turns.handoff`, read from `package.pacing.scenes` for the scene (read how `_nudge_after_turns` in `storygame/runtime/engine.py` finds a scene window and which attribute holds the handoff turn; if no handoff attribute exists use the scene window's latest turn and say so in the notes)), `plan.facts` (every fact id in `when` and `sets` is a declared story fact: find where the package keeps declared fact ids, for example the `world`/`facts` declarations the gap rules use, and accept exactly those), `plan.exit_trigger` (a beat may not set a fact that any exit transition of the scene lists in its triggers or that an exit's earned conditions require, because a beat must never create an exit by itself; use `package.pacing.transitions` with `source_scene_id`), `plan.text` (the text is non-blank, 20 to 600 characters, contains no braces, no word `TODO`, and does not contain any declared fact id, claim id or storylet id as a whole word); for set_text: `plan.address` (the address resolves with `storygame.story_source.lookup.story_text(address, package=package)` and ends in `.text` or `.says`... accept only a `.text` field), `plan.text` (same text rules) and `plan.unchanged` (the new text must differ from the current text).
(3) `build_evidence(ticket_payload: dict, package) -> dict`: the packet a planner model reads. JSON-serialisable and bounded: `{"scene": ..., "failing_turns": [{"key","player_input","narration" (cut to 500 characters),"candidates_offered","matched_candidate","outcome"}...], "candidates": {id: {"earn_when": ..., "requires": [...], "text": (the claim's delivery text cut to 400 characters), "source": (file path from the story lookup when available)}} for every candidate id offered in any failing turn (skip an id the package does not know), "scene_window": {"min","nudge","handoff"} from the scene's pacing window, "beats": [{"id","at_turn","when","sets","trailing"}] the scene's existing pacing events, "exits": [{"id","triggers","to"}] the scene's exit transitions, "fix_menu": [the two kinds with a one-line description each and the precedent ids above]}. Keep the whole packet under about 12,000 characters (truncate the lists, never the structure) and make its output order deterministic.
(4) A small CLI: `python -m factory.stations.fix_plan evidence TICKET.json [--story ROOT]` prints the evidence JSON; `python -m factory.stations.fix_plan lint PLAN.json --ticket TICKET.json [--story ROOT]` prints one problem per line and exits 0 (clean), 1 (problems) or 2 (bad input). `--story` defaults to the repository's default story root (see `DEFAULT_ROOT` in `factory/checks/gap_delta.py`).

TESTS in `tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py` (a NEW file, hermetic, no model, no network; load the real default story once at module level; use a hand-built ticket payload for scene 1A with two failing packets whose `candidates_offered` are real 1A reveal ids): one passing plan of each kind (a beat that points at the truck and laptop at turn 10 with `when` memory_card_recovered true and michelle_lead_actionable false, verbatim true, trailing true, and a set_text plan that changes a claim's delivery text) returns no problems; then ONE failing mutation per rule id (`plan.shape`, `plan.kind`, `plan.scene`, `plan.evidence`, `plan.reason`, `plan.beat_id` both pattern and duplicate, `plan.beat_turn` below 1 and at or above the handoff, `plan.facts`, `plan.exit_trigger`, `plan.text` for each text rule, `plan.address`, `plan.unchanged`) each asserting its rule id appears; the evidence packet is deterministic (two calls equal), JSON-serialisable, under the size bound, includes each offered candidate's earn_when, and skips an unknown id; the CLI exit codes 0, 1 and 2; and a test that the module source contains none of the strings `michelle`, `kristin`, `memory_card`, `1A` as story-specific words (the module may mention scene id patterns only as parameters). The whole file runs in under 15 seconds.

ALSO. `tests/shard_durations.json` must list the new test file: run `.venv/bin/python scripts/regen_shard_durations.py --missing-only` once after the tests pass (read its usage first) and keep the diff to that one added entry.

HARD LIMITS. Edit only the three files above. Never edit `factory/config/`, `factory/checks/`, `factory/guard.py`, `factory/limits.py`, story data, `storygame/` or any other test. Write NOTES_18B1.txt (worktree root, never committed) listing every ambiguity and your choice.
tasks.check:
set -eo pipefail
WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-fix-plan
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
git add -A -- factory tests
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -vxF -e factory/stations/fix_plan.py -e tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py -e tests/shard_durations.json || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
n=$(git diff --cached -U0 -- tests/shard_durations.json | grep -E '^[+-][^+-]' | grep -vc 'test_factory_fix_plan' || true)
[ "${n:-0}" -le 2 ] || { echo "shard_durations diff is more than the one new entry"; exit 1; }
if grep -n -i -E "michelle|kristin|memory_card|laptop" factory/stations/fix_plan.py; then echo "story-specific word in fix_plan.py"; exit 1; fi
if grep -n -i -E "import (openai|anthropic|requests|httpx)|from (openai|anthropic|requests|httpx)|urllib.request|subprocess" factory/stations/fix_plan.py; then echo "no model client, network or subprocess in fix_plan.py"; exit 1; fi
probe="$WORK/out/probe.out"
.venv/bin/python - > "$probe" 2>&1 <<'PY' || true
import json
from pathlib import Path

from factory.stations.fix_plan import build_evidence, lint_plan
from storygame.story_package.loader import load_story_package

pkg = load_story_package(Path("data/stories/continuity-initiative"))
ticket = {"parent": "p", "class": "story_data", "scene": "1A", "failing_turns": [
    {"key": "1A-r1-t6", "scene": "1A", "player_input": "Examine my memory card.", "narration": "x",
     "candidates_offered": ["k_sl_1a_b_r2", "k_sl_1a_j_r3"], "matched_candidate": None, "outcome": "committed"}]}
plan = {"version": 1, "ticket_id": "t", "scene": "1A", "kind": "add_pacing_beat", "reason": "player never learns to read the card",
        "evidence_keys": ["1A-r1-t6"],
        "beat": {"id": "card_pointer_1a", "at_turn": 10, "text": "Her truck sits at the curb, her laptop on the passenger seat. Whatever is on the card, she can read it there.",
                 "verbatim": True, "trailing": True, "when": {"memory_card_recovered": True, "michelle_lead_actionable": False}, "sets": {}}}
assert lint_plan(plan, ticket, pkg) == [], lint_plan(plan, ticket, pkg)
bad = json.loads(json.dumps(plan)); bad["beat"]["at_turn"] = 99
assert any(p.startswith("plan.beat_turn") for p in lint_plan(bad, ticket, pkg))
bad = json.loads(json.dumps(plan)); bad["beat"]["id"] = "patrol_leaves_1a"
assert any(p.startswith("plan.beat_id") for p in lint_plan(bad, ticket, pkg))
bad = json.loads(json.dumps(plan)); bad["evidence_keys"] = ["nope"]
assert any(p.startswith("plan.evidence") for p in lint_plan(bad, ticket, pkg))
ev = build_evidence(ticket, pkg)
text = json.dumps(ev)
assert len(text) < 14000 and "k_sl_1a_b_r2" in text and "earn_when" in text, len(text)
assert json.dumps(build_evidence(ticket, pkg)) == text
print("probe ok")
PY
cat "$probe"
grep -q "probe ok" "$probe" || { echo "probe failed (fails before the module exists, on purpose)"; exit 1; }
start=$(date +%s)
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py tests/test_factory_frozen.py tests/test_factory_followups.py tests/test_factory_triage.py
took=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
echo "fix plan and neighbour tests took $took s (budget 60 s)"
[ "$took" -le 60 ] || { echo "over the 60 s budget"; exit 1; }
.venv/bin/python -m ruff check factory/stations/fix_plan.py tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py
.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check factory/stations/fix_plan.py tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py
git diff --cached > "$WORK/out/fix-plan.patch"
test -s "$WORK/out/fix-plan.patch"
tasks.verified: lint_plan accepts a valid beat plan and set_text plan and rejects one mutation per rule; build_evidence is deterministic, bounded and carries each offered candidate's earn_when; CLI exit codes; module is story-agnostic and has no model, network or subprocess; ruff clean; three files changed.
